feeds.title: Expedition Portal
feeds.description: Expedition Portal is an online resource of informative and entertaining editorial for overlanders, travelers and outdoor adventurers.

feeds.title: Exploring Overland
feeds.description: Overland Tech and Travel Advice from the world's most experienced overlanders tests, reviews, opinion, and more.

feeds.title: The Road Chose Me
feeds.description: Detailing Dan's solo 80,000 mile journey around Africa in a modified Jeep Wrangler. Stories, photos and videos from the road

feeds.title: Road Rash Off Road Blog
feeds.description: Road Rash Off Road is an overlanding and exploration rig, roaming the USA, getting lost and documenting the adventures along the way. These adventures are filmed and edited to tell a thrilling story through their YouTube channel, Road Rash Off Road.

feeds.title: Overland Junction Blog
feeds.description: Overland Junction is a retail company that specializes in bringing its customers the best tents for your car trips.

feeds.title: Expedition Overland Blog
feeds.description: Founders Clay Croft and Rachelle Croft lead a team of 'ordinary people doing extraordinary things,' and share via documentary-style video and photography, the sights, struggles, and unique people and places they meet along the way. Expedition Overland (XO) is a team of adventure travelers sharing through video, their exploration of some of the world's most remote places and inspiring others to go on their own adventures.

feeds.title: Artemis Overland Hardware Blog
feeds.description: Artemis Overland Hardware Blog to find Overlanding perspective, motivation, gear, and place to travel. Artemis has been serving the overland and adventure communities for 5 years. We have one of the largest selections of Overlanding products. Our mission is quality products and service. Through our experiences, we can provide both.

feeds.title: Overland Kings Philippines
feeds.description: Overland Kings Philippines is a project to bring Overland adventure to the Philippines. We provide you with the Australian quality gear for your 4wd Rig and outdoor camping passion. From tents, awning, and recovery gear to camping accessories. We only give you the products we have personally tested.

feeds.title: Oasis Overland
feeds.description: Be a part of the adventure travel team, Oasis Overland and enjoy amazing places on earth, including South America, Africa, Europe and Asia. Keep up to date with all the latest news from Oasis.

feeds.title: Satori Africa Blog
feeds.description: Find Satori blogs, news, and featured articles. Get inspired as you are planning your African Safari. Satori Africa is passionate about Africa and its people, food and wine, the memories it helps create wellness, and the beauty of travel. Traveling with us promises to deliver beyond the realms of any other travel memories. We strongly focus on the most exclusive epicurean and wellness experiences.

feeds.title: PikiPiki Overland
feeds.description: We are Michnus and Elsebie, GenX'ers born and bred South African products. Our passions are motorcycle overland travel, amateurish photography, drinking beer, and hitting up friendships with quirky people. We travel slowly and continuously because we are curious about the world, have a passionate craving for distant places, we love adventure enduro, exploring, love to meet interesting people & cultures that will challenge our own beliefs and views.

feeds.title: Far Out Wilderness Blog
feeds.description: The Farout Wilderness Travel Blog takes the time to get to know you so we can design your perfect adventure. We are an outdoor adventure travel company specializing in overland vehicle rentals and tailor-made itineraries in British Columbia. We use our local knowledge and experience to transform your ideas into an authentic and unique adventure.

feeds.title: Drive the Globe | Overland Adventures
feeds.description: Drive the Globe specializes in unique vehicle based expeditions in Africa and other remote areas. We are a leader in vehicle dependent overland adventure travel. Follow up for the latest news in the world of adventure travel, expedition vehicles & overland adventure.

feeds.title: Dare2go
feeds.description: dare2go is the overland travel blog, written with regular tourists & overlanders in mind. We share our life on the road, beautiful photos, and advice from our experiences.

feeds.title: Pioneer Overland Blog
feeds.description: Pioneer Overland is here to get you outdoors and get you overlanding. There is nothing more exciting than an overland adventure, but there things you need to know before heading out into the backcountry to make sure you are prepared. Our blog provides plenty of great tips and tricks for preparing for your next adventure. We are your guide to a great time in the great outdoors.

feeds.title: Getting Lost Again
feeds.description: We are Wendy and Dan, this blog is the story of our past overland travel together with our daughter and what will lead to our future travels, our story starts in 2007, but the seed was sown years before. Read about our thrilling story of both our early European and Australian Overland travel. Discover the breathtaking landscapes, rugged terrains, and hidden gems across both continents.

feeds.title: Mortons on the Move » Overlanding
feeds.description: Mortons on the Move shares articles on Overlanding in the following section of the blog. Mortons on the Move is your source for inspiration, travel destinations, RV knowledge, gear reviews, and more. You'll find everything you need to get ready for whatever adventure awaits.

feeds.title: Take The Truck Blog
feeds.description: We're Patrick and Lindsey. On our blog, you'll find everything you ever wanted to know about our truck bed camper, from how we make it work as a family of three, to tips for staying sane and organized in a tiny space, and tons of information about our DIY build.

feeds.title: Tucks' Truck
feeds.description: Hello and welcome to our web-blog-thing about our Overlanding travels around the world in Cuthbert the Truck. Tucks' Truck is about us; our planning, our routes, our adventures, and particularly our trusty truck.

feeds.title: Expedition Vehicle Outfitters Blog
feeds.description: With over 20 plus years of automotive experience serving Michigan and the surrounding states, we decided to launch Expedition Vehicle Outfitters. Specializing in overland and outdoor adventure up-fitting, our knowledgeable team will help you get the most out of your adventure rig. Whether you're new to outdoor adventure travel, or a seasoned veteran of the road less traveled, we're here to help.

feeds.title: Around The World In 800 Days Blog
feeds.description: Emma Smart and myself (Andy Smith) are two valiant adventurers whose dream is to circumnavigate the planet in our 25 year old Toyota Hilux Surf Bee-bee.

feeds.title: No Hanging Around » Africa Overland Tours
feeds.description: Read articles featuring the beauty of Africa Overland Tours in this segment of No Hanging Around. The main focus of this website is to help you with some of the following are picking the right travel insurance for Africa, finding the best overland tour company in Africa, choosing the most suitable overland tour/activities, and more.

feeds.title: The Wolfpack Overland Adventure Blog
feeds.description: We are a family of overlanders, travelers, adventurers, and explorers. We are constantly hunting for adventure, wildlife, and the beauty of nature. We found solace in nature after enduring a tragedy and are working hard to rebuild our lives in order to allow us to do even more. Follow along to see how it goes and where we go next, and maybe get inspired for your own adventures!

feeds.title: Over The Land We Go
feeds.description: Blog about our overland adventures in our All Terrain Camper equipped Chevy Colorado. Articles cover Gear Reviews, Travel Guides, Overlanding, and All-Terrain Camper

feeds.title: World Overlanders
feeds.description: We are Pete and Kirsten, and we are overland travel addicts. Having been lucky enough to work in the overland tour industry for many years including owning our own overland travel company, we are now heading off on independent overland adventures with our 2 kids. You can read about all our past journeys and upcoming adventures in a custom-built overland truck.

feeds.title: Benny Goes Overland
feeds.description: Join us on our travels to exciting Overlanding destinations with our Mercedes Vario 4x4. Our goal is to drive the Panamericana.

feeds.title: Ole Man Overland Blog
feeds.description: Hey there, I'm Pete - a lifelong camper, photographer, and nature enthusiast. Ole Man Overland can help you sift through the noise, use our Media Guides and Trusted Resource Lists to help you to identify the right advice and the best options for gear and equipment that will help make your Overlanding experience the best it can be.

feeds.title: Gondirtin Blog
feeds.description: We are Karissa and Linhbergh. We are full-time commercial photographers living in Los Angeles, California. Here, you'll find all kinds of different meal recipes to cook while on the road, during a weekend camp trip, or even something to cook up at home.

feeds.title: Overlanding North America
feeds.description: Overlanding North America is a Veteran Owned Small Business dedicated to family, exploring, and the Pursuit of Adventure. We don't like to compromise on comfort when we're on the trail, but with the type of places we like to go, weight and size matter. We felt a responsibility to our fellow adventure families to share these amazing trailers that can go off-grid, and get you where you want to go while keeping your family in safety and comfort for your journeys wherever they take you!

feeds.title: Overland Lady Blog
feeds.description: As one of those ladies on the road, and one who enjoys sharing moments, I am recording on this blog my joy, laughter, frustration, and everything in between. I seek to connect with other Overlanding ladies, share our adventure stories from a female's perspective, inspire girls out there who want to go explore and support traveling females with our knowledge and experiences.

feeds.title: Overlanding Sophia Blog
feeds.description: Hello and welcome! We're Chesca and Ben. We live full time on the road in our Mercedes Sprinter van called Sophia. Inspired by a love for adventure and alternative living, we document our lives as we travel the globe, experiencing new landscapes and cultures while living in a van. We share our journey with the hope you'll be inspired to start your own version of van life, whatever that might look like for you.

feeds.title: Overland Bound
feeds.description: We are a global community of adventure seekers and explorers. To support our Members Overland Bound creates software to connect each other, create trips and events, and provide map locations and other essential adventure resources.

feeds.title: Trans-Americas Journey
feeds.description: Trans Americas Journey documents two travel journalists and a truck traveling full-time in the Americas to uncover fresh information about where to go, what to eat, where to sleep, and what to do in North, Central, and South America so you can travel better.

feeds.title: 247Overland Blog
feeds.description: Darren and Becky share the planning, preparation, highs and lows, the real life stuff and travel review, advice, guide to the world, and the adventure along the way.
